_doc: Ambient one-liners (speech bubbles). Lines may use the copy grammar from data/copy.json (#product#, #dish#, #faction_short.cap#, {planet}) and {name} = the player. Keys: role, 'infamous', 'crisis:<id>', 'station', 'combat', 'pair' (NPC-to-NPC: 'A -- B -- C' alternates speakers), reactive keys (famous, wanted, rich_player, biome:<env> ...), and enemy lines '<kind>:<enemy_type>' with kind = taunt / hurt / yield / standdown.
civilian: Is it just me or did the air get pricier?
My lungs are on a payment plan.
Don't make eye contact with the ads.
I sold my dreams to Lumen. They're running them as reruns.
Three jobs and I still can't afford silence.
Heard the Odd Duck is back in port. Smells like it.
My kid wants to be a shareholder when she grows up.
Paragon fined me for loitering in my own shadow.
Third shift today. The paste tastes like Tuesday.
My landlord charges for the echo. I whisper now.
Saw a real bird once. Lumen said it was a drone.
If you squint, the smog looks like a sunset. I squint a lot.
My kid wants to be a billboard when they grow up.
They raised the price of standing still.
Whoever invented the jingle, I hope their air runs out.
Ten more years and I own my own lungs.
Rain's free. For now. Drink up.
Heard the Consortium patented Mondays.
Don't make eye contact with the drones. They upsell.
I miss the old ads. They only lied a little.
I'm not crying. The smog has a promotional flavour today.
My rent went up because my window faces a better ad.
They put a toll on the stairs. I live on the stairs now.
Lumen says I'm in the top ten percent of happy. I never filled in the survey.
Tried to complain. The complaint line has a waiting list for the waiting list.
My horoscope came with terms and conditions.
I put my savings into #brand#. Now my savings are a jingle.
Smell that? That's {planet}. It's always {planet}.
Somebody stole my umbrella. Then billed me for the rain.
#thing.cap# used to be free. My nan told me. She's in collections now.
I'd leave {planet}, but the exit fee is my whole skeleton.
My job is watching ads so the ads feel watched.
Ever notice the drones hum the jingle? Now you can't un-notice it.
Got a raise! It's paid in coupons for #product#.
Don't step on the yellow tiles. Those are premium tiles.
The vending machine said 'thank you'. I've never felt so seen.
Paid off my debt yesterday. They found more of it this morning.
My fridge unionised. Now it only opens on weekdays.
I've been on hold with #faction# since spring.
Every time I sneeze I get a 'Bless You' invoice.
Who keeps feeding the repo drones? They're getting bold.
The noodle guy knows my name. He's the only one who does.
Heard there's a street on {planet} where the ads stop. Nobody's come back to confirm.
I counted the stars last night. Two. Both satellites.
#weather.cap#, they said. They were right, for once.
I'm a #job#. It's a real job. It's on my debt statement.
My therapist is an ad for a better therapist.
Is it Tuesday? Everything tastes like Tuesday.
merchant: Air canisters! Bottled at the source! The source is a vent!
Everything must go! Including me, if Halcyon finds out.
Fresh from the vat! Very fresh! Still moving!
Get your #dish# here, before the inspectors do!
Real fruit! Okay, real-ish! Okay, a picture of fruit!
Cheaper than #brand#! Probably safer! No promises!
Bootleg tapes of #media_product#! Ending NOT censored!
Spare filters! Your lungs will thank you! In instalments!
Lucky charms! Protects against debt, drones and Tuesdays!
Come closer, I don't bite. The paste does, a little.
Best prices on {planet}! Ask anyone! Don't ask anyone!
recruit: Anyone hiring? I'll work for air.
I need off this rock. Like, yesterday.
Looking for a crew that isn't a cult. Or is a fun cult.
I can fix anything with tape and spite. Hire me.
I'm cheap, I'm loyal, and I'm only a little bit wanted.
Got a ship? I'll scrub it. I'll scrub YOU. Just get me off {planet}.
I don't need pay. I need a window that isn't an ad.
infamous: I hear they rob vending machines for fun.
Hide your credits, the drifter's here.
Is that the one who did the thing? With the... the thing?
My cousin saw what you did. He hasn't slept since. Thanks?
Paragon said not to talk to you. So: hi.
Please don't do whatever it is you do. To me.
combat: I'm calling Paragon! ...Their hold music is so long!
Not in front of the noodle stand!
I just bought these shoes on credit!
Is this an ad?! Tell me this is an ad!
Why is it always MY street?!
Great. Now the rent's going up.
I'm too in debt to die!
pair: ...and then the billboard ASKED me how my day was.
Protein Paste tastes like regret today.
You hear about the debt strike?
Lumen said it's sunny. It's raining. Lumen's never wrong.
My cousin got repossessed last week.
Wanna split an air canister?
Did you pay your air this week? -- Define 'pay'.
Paste or noodles? -- Noodles are paste with ambition.
I got promoted! -- To what? -- Unpaid senior intern.
You hear about the new tax? -- Which one? -- Exactly.
Did you vote? -- For what? -- Exactly. They didn't say.
My kid wants to be a hologram. -- That's ambitious. -- She wants to be the ad, not the actor.
I think the billboard's flirting with me. -- It flirts with everyone. -- Don't ruin this for me.
Lend me five? -- For what? -- Air. -- ...Fine. Breathe slowly.
Have you tried #product#? -- #review#
Did you watch #media_product#? -- #show_opinion#
I'm saving up for #aspiration#. -- Same. -- We're never getting it, are we? -- Nope.
Is it raining? -- It's always raining. -- I meant indoors.
They fired #first#. -- Why? -- Unlicensed smiling.
What's for dinner? -- #dish#. -- Again? -- It's always #dish#.
The #team# won! -- They lost. -- They won in my heart. -- Your heart's in collections.
Who's that? -- Don't stare. -- I'm not staring, I'm admiring with my eyes.
My cousin works for #faction# now. -- #job_complaint# -- Yeah, that's the one.
Did your rent go up? -- Twice. -- Twice? -- Once for the rent, once for asking.
I had a dream last night. -- Was it sponsored? -- ...It was, actually.
Heard they're going to #absurd_policy_lower#. -- They can't do that. -- They did it on {planet} last year.
How's the new job? -- I'm a #job# now. -- Is that... good? -- It's a job.
Shh. Drone. -- Act natural. -- I AM natural. -- Too natural. Buy something.
station: This station's been dead since the repo drones moved in.
Cryo-bay's full of collateral. Some of them still snore.
Halcyon's drones are scanning everything. Even the rats.
Somebody's still paying rent on cryo-pod 9. Forty years of rent.
The lights flicker in code. I think they're asking for a raise.
Don't take the left corridor. It bills by the step.
Old station, old debts. Even the rust owes money.
The vending machine here only takes coins from before the war.
crisis:air_bubble: Breathing futures are up again. I'm shorting my lungs.
My air canister was worth more than my flat this morning. Now it's worth a sandwich.
Analysts say breathing is overvalued. I say breathing is breathing.
I'm holding my breath until prices drop. Day three.
Sold my lungs at the peak. Bought them back at the peak. Don't ask.
crisis:debt_strike: We're not paying! They can't repossess ALL of us. ...Can they?
Solidarity! Also, does anyone have a spare filter?
My landlord tried to evict me. I evicted him back. It's legal now. I think.
The repo drones are confused. Nobody's answering the door.
First proper sleep in years. Turns out debt is loud.
crisis:paste_recall: They found a tooth in Batch 88. Not a human tooth. Not an animal tooth.
Batch 88 is fine, they said. Batch 88 blinked at me.
I've eaten paste every day for twenty years and I'm FINE. I'm fine. I'm fine.
Recall notice says 'return unused portions'. What about the used portions?
Gristle's offering a coupon for the next batch. As compensation.
crisis:ad_overload: Even my dreams have unskippable ads now.
I blinked and an ad played behind my eyelids.
My shadow has a sponsor now.
I tried to scream and it came out as a jingle.
They're selling ad space on the rain. Every drop.
crisis:compliance_week: Report a neighbour, win a toaster! I already reported myself twice.
I smiled at a stranger. Got a commendation AND a fine.
My neighbour reported my neighbour. I reported them both. We're all getting toasters.
Compliance week: they check your pockets, your heart and your search history.
Be compliant. Be visible. Be home by curfew. Be quiet about it.
famous: Can I get a selfie? I'll pay. Three credits?
My cousin's a big fan. Also a big Paragon informant.
You look shorter in real life.
Is it true what Lumen says about you?
{name}! I named my pet drone after you!
Can you say my name? It's for my funeral playlist.
Is it true you punched a billboard once?
Lumen's doing a series on you. It's mostly lies. I love it.
wanted: That's the face from the posters...
Don't look. DON'T LOOK. Okay, look a little.
There's a reward for you, you know. A big one.
Paragon's been asking about you all week.
I didn't see you. I don't see anybody. I'm blind on Thursdays.
Paragon says you're armed and handsome. Or dangerous. I forget which.
If they ask, I was never here. If they pay, I was totally here.
rich_player: Nice coat. Real fabric? Must be nice.
Rich people don't come down here unless they're buying the street.
Did your shoes cost more than my block?
Are you lost, boss? The rich part is upwards.
Look, a shareholder in the wild!
poor_player: You look like you slept under the ad-bridge too.
Hang in there. Nobody else will.
Need a tip? The noodle stand gives leftovers after midnight.
The shelter on the corner has heat on Wednesdays.
You look hungry. I'm hungry too. Let's be hungry together.
Want half my paste? It's the bad half.
old_player: Respect, grandparent. You survived this long.
My nan says air used to be free. She's a liar, right? Right?
Back in your day, was the sky blue? Mine's billed monthly.
You've got stories. I can tell. Most of them illegal.
young_player: Shouldn't you be in a learning-subscription?
Kids these days. Already in debt. Respect.
Aren't you a bit young for {planet}?
Go home, kid. Oh. This is home. Sorry.
liberated: No owners here anymore. Just us. It's chaos. It's wonderful.
We vote on things now. Mostly about noise. But we VOTE.
Paragon left. The air smells different. Better? Different.
We painted over the billboards. Now it's just walls. Lovely, quiet walls.
Free air on Fridays! Every day is Friday now!
story_good: Things got better around here. Someone actually helped.
Did you hear? Someone stood up for us.
I don't know who fixed it, but I'd buy them a drink.
My kid laughed today. Out loud. For free.
Feels lighter around here. Must be the air. Or the people.
story_bad: Things got worse. Somebody sold us out.
Ever since that 'deal', nothing's been right here.
If I find who broke the strike...
They doubled the curfew. Then they doubled it again.
Don't trust anyone with a clipboard. Not anymore.
biome:neon_sprawl: The sky is ads all the way up.
Watch out for low-flying cars. They don't stop for pedestrians. Or physics.
Rain again. It's always raining here. They bill by the drop.
If you're lost, follow the noodle smell.
The puddles reflect the ads. Even the ground is selling.
biome:toxic_swamp: Don't drink the water. Don't touch the water. Don't LOOK at the water.
My boots dissolved last week. Good boots.
The frogs here have three eyes. Two of them are cameras.
Smells like money. Wet, rotting money.
biome:ad_desert: That billboard's been playing the same jingle for a hundred years.
It's not snow. It's shredded plastic. Breathe through your scarf.
Cold enough to freeze your debt. Almost.
The dunes are made of old flyers. Read one, it's a coupon.
Out here the jingle is the only weather.
biome:rust_canyon: Seventy percent of the planet's gone. The other thirty is on layaway.
Hear that rumble? That's either the mine or the planet giving up.
Rust in your teeth, rust in your lungs. Home.
The canyon echoes. They charge for the echo.
My pickaxe is on lease. So is my back.
biome:crystal_moon: The crystals hum at night. Halcyon says it's 'asset noise'.
Don't touch the glowing ones. They're collateral.
Pretty, isn't it? Repossessed, but pretty.
Listen. The crystals are humming the jingle.
taunt:paragon_officer: Halt! Your loitering fee is overdue!
Stop resisting! It's billed by the minute!
You have the right to remain profitable!
Citizen! You're in breach of the new rule to #absurd_policy_lower#!
Hands where my bodycam can monetise them!
Paragon! Freeze! And smile for the feed!
This arrest is brought to you by #brand#!
Suspect sighted. Uploading your face to the ad network.
hurt:paragon_officer: Assaulting an officer is a premium offence!
Ow! That's going on your file! And your credit score!
yield:paragon_officer: Okay! Okay! I'm off the clock!
Don't! I've got a pension! Almost!
I just work here! I barely work here!
standdown:paragon_officer: Copy. Standing down. Billing someone else.
taunt:repo_drone: RESISTANCE WILL BE ADDED TO YOUR BALANCE.
THIS REPOSSESSION IS RECORDED FOR QUALITY PURPOSES.
yield:repo_drone: DEBT FORGIVEN. JOKE. PLEASE DO NOT SHOOT.
taunt:debt_brute: I collect. Debts, teeth, whatever's loose.
Interest is compounding, and so am I!
hurt:debt_brute: My chiropractor's gonna hear about this!
yield:debt_brute: I got kids! Well, I got debts shaped like kids!
standdown:debt_brute: Boss says leave it. Lucky you.
taunt:pirate: Your cargo or your credit score!
Nice ship. Shame if it got repossessed. By me.
We're not pirates, we're freelance logistics!
Hand it over! All of it! The paste too!
No Consortium out here, friend. Just us.
hurt:pirate: Argh! That was my good arm!
You'll pay for that! In actual money!
That's coming out of your share!
yield:pirate: Parley! Parley! That's still a thing, right?
Take it! Take the loot! I was gonna fence it anyway!
